notes.title: Deconstruction tool
notes.content:
[p]Great news fellow astronauts - the deconstruction tool is ready! Now, if you want to change your construction, you can easily do it by deconstructing it into parts. In this case, the resources spent on the construction will be placed back into the inventory.[/p][p]Add the game to your wishlist and subscribe to the YouTube channel, see you there![/p][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="xV27rzarygI;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Cooperative mode
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow astronauts!
This time, you won't be flying to the moon alone, but with a companion – thanks to our new technology, we can fly several people there at once. Explore the surroundings and build your first base.
Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist and subscribe to the YouTube channel. Until next time!

[previewyoutube=NOy3bcdvMbM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Welcome to the Moon!
notes.content:
The lunar module has landed, and you can take your first walk on the lunar surface. Oxygen, nutrition, and health are normal. You can collect the first samples of lunar minerals and break them down into their elements. Construction mode is ready, and the first blueprints for a living module and equipment are available. You can craft various items in the crafting machine.
Add the game to your wishlist and subscribe to the YouTube channel. 
Until next time!

[previewyoutube=jiPbZVdPi54;full][/previewyoutube]
